title: allow-documented-pr-recovery-20260727
outOfScope: Changing immutable tags or Draft Releases
General multi-Work-Item PRs without documented recovery evidence

sources.reason: The PR gate rejects the user-authorized recovery pair in #401.
User authorized recorded same-PR recovery and requires a durable process fix.

riskAssessment.reason: Repository-local PR validation and tests only; the exception remains fail-closed and no provider action occurs.

executionDecision.reason: User authorized a documented recovery mechanism; tests must prove all other multi-Work-Item PRs remain blocked.

preReviewWarnings: Do not broaden the one Work Item/one PR default; permit only an adjacent archived recovery whose predecessor is already in the PR and whose Contract records user authorization.

checkpointPolicy.reason: Record at least one checkpoint before finishing to reduce mid-task drift.

acceptance: PR validation permits exactly one explicitly authorized, immediately following recovery Work Item only when its archived predecessor is also in the PR.
The recovery Contract must name the predecessor through a source reference, record human authorization, and use a baseCommit descended from the predecessor's historical base.
All ordinary multi-Work-Item PRs and unrelated base divergences remain rejected by regression tests.
RFE-ISSUE-074 records the controlled exception and continuing lifecycle.
guidelines: Preserve the one Work Item/one PR default and make every exception deterministic and auditable.
Do not weaken immutable-tag or release-publication boundaries.

intent.problem: PR #401 contains an archived corrective Work Item and a user-authorized recovery Work Item because the former's CI cannot pass until candidate v0.5.45 is recorded. The PR gate rejects that auditable recovery pair, creating a lifecycle cycle.
constraints: Allow only one adjacent recovery pair.
Require explicit predecessor and user authority evidence.
Keep all other multi-Work-Item PRs fail-closed.
intent.rationale: The gate must recognize the documented recovery relation rather than force an impossible new PR or silently bypass ownership and archive checks.

rawUserRequest: Adding v0.5.45 to the archived but unmerged #401 is acceptable; correct the process so it cannot recur. Continue without further confirmation unless a real authority boundary requires it.

declaredIntent.summary: Permit only a fully evidenced sequential recovery pair in one PR while preserving the normal one-Work-Item rule.

scenarioCoverage.scenario: ordinary multiple Work Items remain rejected

restrictedWriteApproval.reason: The user explicitly authorized the v0.5.45 recovery in unmerged PR #401 and directed that the PR process defect be corrected without further confirmation.

rollbackNote: Revert this Work Item diff and restore related tests and docs.
